# neutral-template

> The layout every non-product Figentra repository starts from: Figentra Flow's neutral preset, with agent setup, GitHub setup, pinned tools and hooks, and no product code.

## Docs

- [STATE.md](STATE.md): what is proven by a real run, what is only declared, and open risks (2026-11-07)
- [README.md](README.md): front page and quick start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent rules (rendered by fflow; do not edit)
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): the docs index for this repository
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how changes land and what the root may hold

## Entry points

- [flow.config.json](flow.config.json): the Flow preset; source of the rendered files
- [.flow/readme.yml](.flow/readme.yml): the data README.md is rendered from
- [mise.toml](mise.toml): pinned tools
- [lefthook.yml](lefthook.yml): git hooks
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): the Quality Gate
- [.github/rulesets/main.json](.github/rulesets/main.json): the main branch ruleset
- [.github/CODEOWNERS](.github/CODEOWNERS): code owners
- [.agents/rules/worktrees.md](.agents/rules/worktrees.md): the worktree rule
